items.label: DESIGNED GYM BAG
items.value: This small gym bag is designed for gym. Its' 14" size fits perfectly for gym locker. It can hold a pair of shoes, change clothes, water bottle, and other essentials for gym.

items: CARRY ON SIZE：This carry on duffel bag is perfect for storing personal items while traveling and can be carried on the plane with you, easily fits under United Airlines seat when filled to capacity.

items.label: WELL STRUCTURED
items.value: This weekender bag is very well constructed and sturdy, it can keep its shape even when it is empty.

items.label: HIGH QUALITY
items.value: This is a very functional and versatile mini duffle bag, made of high quality 600D water & tear resistant polyester material, lightweight but well made. The smooth metal zipper is strong and durable.There is no cover above the zipper for easy opening, no worry about sticking.

items.label: EASY CARRYING
items.value: The small duffel bag has a detachable shoulder strap. The length of the shoulder strap can be adjusted freely, and can be carried on one shoulder or crossbody by adjusting different lengths. There are two hand straps on the top for easy carrying.
